reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs contain no most-favoured-nation, price-matching or 'terms no less favourable' undertaking; §1 expressly confirms a non-exclusive arrangement and §5 is a pure revenue-share mechanic with no third-party benchmarking.

The rule is directional (flag only where Customer must extend best terms to the Vendor); absence of any MFN burden on Customer matches the preferred position, so no redline or negotiation issue is warranted.
Redline text is identical to the originals and no comment was added, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; deterministic checks are empty and raise no concerns.
